subject.title: improve(agents): reduce per-turn conversation metadata tokens

question: Should this model-visible prompt compaction land after a real provider run confirms that the removed redundancy does not reduce agent handling of mention, reply-chain, forwarded, or media context?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit owner handling, and automated tests cannot establish semantic equivalence in an LLM/provider path.

options.title: Require live agent proof
options.body: Capture a redacted after-fix provider transcript or runtime log that exercises compact metadata plus an explicit mention and reply/forward or media context.

options.title: Accept automated coverage
options.body: An owner may explicitly accept the snapshot and focused-test evidence in place of live provider behavior proof if the cache and model-behavior tradeoff is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require live agent proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted after-fix provider transcript or runtime log that exercises compact metadata plus an explicit mention and reply/forward or media context.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author is the clearest available routing candidate for the agent prompt contract and its intended cache tradeoff.
